..Title
Resolution to Approve Revised Bylaws of the Housing & Human Services Advisory Board (HHSAB)
..Memorandum
The bylaws have been reviewed by the City Attorney's Office and comport with the standard bylaws format consistent with Council Resolution R-08-496.
..Staff
Prepared by:	Tara Cohen, Housing & Infrastructure Manager, Office of Community & Economic Development   
Reviewed by:	Christopher Frost, Senior Assistant City Attorney 
..Body
Whereas, The Housing and Human Services Advisory Body (HHSAB) approved the revised bylaws at its April 13, 2023 meeting; and

Whereas, City Council has passed a resolution requiring all proposed bylaws of City boards and commissions to be approved by City Council; 

RESOLVED, That City Council approves the attached bylaws.
